title: Perth 2029 is live: pre-registration opens for the world's biggest masters games
imgAlt: Perth skyline over the Swan River
excerpt: The World Masters Games returns to Australia for the first time in 20 years. Registration of interest is now open — free, no commitment, first access to Early Bird pricing.
body:
World Masters Games Perth 2029 will be held from 12–23 October 2029, bringing 30,000 athletes from more than 100 nations to Western Australia. It is the world's biggest multi-sport participation event — open to everyone who meets the minimum age for their sport (most from 30, some from 25), with no qualification required.

Pre-registration is free and takes under a minute. Pre-registrants get first access to Early Bird pricing when paid registration opens in October 2028, sport-specific updates as the program is confirmed, and early previews of official travel packages.

Australia has hosted the World Masters Games three times — Brisbane 1994, Melbourne 2002 and Sydney 2009. Perth 2029 is the nation's return to the world stage, four years out from the Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

title: 55+ sports, 40 venues, 9 clusters: the proposed Perth 2029 sports program
excerpt: From swimming at Perth's new HPC pool to open-water racing at Cottesloe Beach — explore the proposed program, sport by sport.
body:
The proposed Perth 2029 program spans more than 55 sports and disciplines across nine compact venue clusters — from Optus Stadium in the city to Champion Lakes Regatta Centre, the Whiteman Park International Shooting Complex and the white sand of Cottesloe, City Beach and Scarborough.

The biggest expected fields: football (up to 2,690 athletes), swimming (2,360), basketball (1,930), track & field (1,800), hockey (1,480) and rowing (1,380). Sports will be progressively confirmed from late 2027, with the final program locked before registration opens in October 2028.

Every sport is organised in age groups — typically five-year bands from the minimum age up — so you compete against your peers, whether you're 32 or 82.

title: Kansai 2027 → Perth 2029: one masters journey, two great Games
imgAlt: Osaka castle and city skyline at dusk
excerpt: Going to the World Masters Games in Kansai, Japan? Perth is your next chapter — and we're making the journey seamless.
body:
World Masters Games 2027 Kansai (14–30 May 2027) is set to be the biggest masters games in history, targeting 50,000 participants. Perth 2029 and the Kansai Organising Committee are working together under a formal agreement so that the masters journey continues seamlessly from Japan to Western Australia.

If you're competing at Kansai, look for the Perth 2029 pavilion at the Games — meet our ambassadors, get your sport's Perth preview, and register your interest on the spot for first access to Early Bird pricing.

Perth is closer than you think: direct flights from Tokyo, and October 2029 gives you 29 months to plan the trip.

title: Why October in Perth is the best weather call in world sport
excerpt: 21°C average, eight hours of daily sunshine, ocean at its clearest. Here's what athletes can expect.
body:
Perth in October is wildflower-season spring: average maximums around 21°C, low humidity, light winds in the morning and the famous 'Fremantle Doctor' sea breeze in the afternoon — near-perfect conditions for endurance sport, racquet sport and everything in between.

It's also the sunniest capital city in Australia, with more sunshine hours than any other. For travelling supporters, October means whale-watching season on the coast, wildflowers in Kings Park, and beach weather without the summer heat.

Pack for warm days, mild evenings, and exactly one regret: not staying longer.

title: 5,000 volunteers will make these Games. Want in?
excerpt: Volunteer recruitment opens in 2028 — but you can raise your hand now and be first in line.
body:
It takes around 5,000 to 6,000 volunteers to run a World Masters Games — at venues, the Games Village, ceremonies, transport hubs and across the city. Volunteers are the face of the Games and the single biggest reason athletes go home raving about a host city.

Formal recruitment opens in 2028, with training through 2029. Roles span sport operations, athlete services, transport, medical support, media and more. All volunteers are 18+.

Register your interest now and you'll be the first to hear when applications open.

title: Calling all club captains: bring your whole crew to Perth
imgAlt: Team huddle on a sports field
excerpt: Masters sport travels in packs. Club groups of 5+ get 10% off — and clubs that bring big numbers unlock rewards up to Games Village naming rights.
body:
The best masters trips are club trips. When registration opens in October 2028, clubs registering five or more members get 10% off every registration — and club milestone rewards stack up from there: a club banner at your venue at 10 registrations, a feature on the Perth 2029 channels at 25, your own Games Village marquee session at 50, and a CEO welcome video plus Village naming rights for one social event at 100+.

Team captains get a dedicated dashboard to manage their group, a direct line to the Perth 2029 team, and a priority pack-collection window when they arrive.

Captains: register your interest now and flag your club — we'll set you up before the rush.
